tool.name: mOTUs DB fetcher
tool.description: Fetches the DB required for mOTUs

param.name: test_data_manager
param.label: Copy minimal test DB and create mock data table entry.
Database Version
param.help: Check https://zenodo.org/records/7778108 for current version. The default value is recommended.

param.name: db_value
param.label: Database identifier override
param.help: Value stored in the data table and used as the on-disk directory name. Leave empty to default to db_from_<Zenodo publication date> (e.g. db_from_2023-03-28). Set it to reproduce or match an existing entry from another server (e.g. db_from_2026-04-27T094930Z).

tool.help:
mOTUs =====
The mOTUs profiler is a tool designed for taxonomic profiling of metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data. It allows for the identification and quantification of microbial community composition directly from sequencing reads. mOTUs utilizes a database of marker genes identified across a wide range of microbial taxa, enabling the detection of known and unknown microorganisms in your sample data.
Additional Resources ====================
For a more comprehensive understanding of mOTUs and detailed usage instructions, please visit the mOTUs GitHub repository:
mOTUs GitHub Repository: [https://github.com/motu-tool/mOTUs](https://github.com/motu-tool/mOTUs)
Data Manager ============
This DM download the available DBs from: https://zenodo.org/records/5012106
